events.upload_dialog_rules:
Supported input: an English-language telecom financial report in USD with an income statement (annual or interim). Evi reads three metrics: consolidated revenue, operating profit (operating income) and net income attributable to the parent.
Limits: one unencrypted PDF, at most 10 MiB and 250 pages.
What is sent where: uploading only stores the file and counts its pages. When you press Process, Docling parses the one page you selected on Evi’s server, and that page’s text and table cells are sent to SERV for extraction. Reppo is never called automatically.
